messages:
olivia_billing: Heads up — Acme Labs' UK IBAN setup failed during verification with the bank. They returned rejection code `U05` (beneficiary name mismatch). Need options to get them live for tomorrow's invoice. @jake_ops @maria_finance

jake_ops: Can you paste the exact rejection text / any error payload? Screenshot helps.

olivia_billing: Pasted from bank callback: ```RESPONSE: code=U05; desc='Beneficiary name does not match account records'```
Customer filled trading name 'Acme Labs UK Ltd' but legal name is 'Acme Laboratories Ltd'.

maria_finance: Name mismatch is common. Options: 1) update invoice/legal name to match bank (needs docs), 2) request bank letter from customer confirming account name, 3) accept manual wire with KYC + finance approval. Which is fastest for them?

csm_rafael: Pinged the customer's AP team. They said accounting cannot change legal name on their bank account quickly. They can provide a bank letter but it will take ~2 business days.

olivia_billing: Invoice due tomorrow. Is there an interim path? Could we accept a manual SWIFT/BIC wire this afternoon instead? Any compliance or ops blockers?

treasury_bot: :robot_face: FYI: Manual wire acceptance policy requires attached KYC + bank letter for name mismatch exceptions. Approval routing: up to $50k can be approved by finance lead. Please attach docs to the payment ticket.

maria_finance: The invoice amount is $12,350 — below $50k. I can approve a manual wire if they provide: (a) scanned bank letter on official letterhead, (b) company registration document showing legal name. Olivia, ask them to include the exact account/IBAN and preferred value date.

olivia_billing: Sending checklist to customer now. Drafted message: "Hi — to process a manual wire for this invoice we need: 1) scanned bank letter confirming account name & IBAN, 2) company registration (incorporation) doc, 3) confirmation of account number, IBAN and BIC/SWIFT, and 4) preferred value date. Once we receive those we'll mark invoice as 'pending manual wire' and extend due date." Will cc @maria_finance.

jake_ops: Also opening an internal ticket to make this flow smoother long-term: fallback routing for SEPA/IBAN rejects (codes like U05/U07) -> allow automatic manual-wire offer and attach required KYC checklist.

olivia_billing: Created billing backlog ticket: BL-4827 - "SEPA rejection fallback routing + auto-checklist". Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BL-4827

csm_rafael: Customer replied — bank letter should arrive tomorrow AM, can you extend the invoice due date by 24-48h? :pray:

maria_finance: I can extend by 48 hours and mark status 'pending manual wire / docs requested'. I'll update invoice metadata and notify collections.

olivia_billing: Thanks — cc'ing @payments-bot to record the manual wire instruction and required attachments.

payments-bot: Manual wire logged for invoice  INV-2026. Please upload KYC attachments to the payment record at /payments/1901234567. Tag @maria_finance when uploaded.
